title: Some of Them Are Old
feel: Slow, gentle sustained strums, about 70 bpm (estimate)

sections.name: Verse / chorus
sections.bars: F Faug | F6 F7 | Bb/D Bb | G C

why: The classic **ascending line cliché** I – I+ – I6 – I7: one finger climbs C–C♯–D–E♭ on the B string. Plus a secondary dominant.
hard_change: **F7 → B♭/D**, a jump from 1st position to the 5th fret. Look at the 5th-fret marker before you leave F7.
theory: The line cliché turns I into V7/IV, which resolves to IV (B♭). G major is V/V → C (V).
steps: Changes alone, slowly: F → Faug → F6 → F7, only the B-string note moving.
caveat: Two agreeing fan transcriptions and no published analysis — voicings vary between transcriptions; trust your ear and your teacher's version.
